summary: A direct, intimate Indonesian motivational monologue: exhausting yourself to be liked by everyone is futile, because no matter what you do — kind, silent, successful, failing — someone will criticize. You cannot control others' opinions, only how much they affect your life; you were never made to be liked by everyone, so live your own life on your own terms.
themes: loss of control over others' judgments
